STORY FIRST.
ALWAYS.

I'm Tahazib, a video editor based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I work across documentaries, explainers, YouTube episodes and news-driven content, shaping footage with rhythm, clarity and intention.

From my own voice-led stories to the pace of a newsroom, the question stays the same: what does this moment need?
